name: A Dark Tale
source:
You will take on the role of Jebediah, a man tormented by the confinement of his house, until one day he receives an unexpected visitor who will change everything...

[From [url=https://coolmachinegames.itch.io/a-dark-tale]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演Jebediah的角色，一个因被禁闭在家里而饱受折磨的男人，直到有一天，他接待了一位不速之客，这将改变一切……

[来自[url=https://coolmachinegames.itch.io/a-dark-tale]Itch.io[/url]]
